_note: Application workloads. 'fault_tolerant' workloads are given in logical resources (algorithm qubits, Toffoli/CCZ count and depth); 'variational' workloads run on physical qubits without error correction. classical_ops is the cost of the best classical alternative where one is quoted (None = no feasible classical method). Resource counts are from the cited papers, rounded. Types: 'fault_tolerant', 'variational', and 'quantum_linear_algebra' (added in the mid-2030s audit: an HHL/QSVT-style job with an EXPLICIT data-loading and read-out overhead; 'claim_quantum_advantage' is false by default and nothing in this package asserts a speed-up for AI or ordinary matrix multiplication).

shor_rsa2048.label: Shor, RSA-2048
shor_rsa2048.source: Gidney, arXiv:2505.15917 (2025): ~1.4k logical qubits, ~6.5e9 Toffoli (secondary-source figure; the 2026-10 audit confirmed the paper's headline claim of under a million noisy qubits in under a week at 0.1 % error / 1 us cycle, and a ~6.5e9 Toffoli count only via a truncated secondary snippet; the 1.4k logical-qubit figure was not found). Classical: GNFS L[1/3] heuristic, order of magnitude.

femoco_thc.label: FeMoco ground-state energy (THC qubitization)
femoco_thc.source: Lee et al., PRX Quantum 2, 030305 (2021); counts as quoted in arXiv:2108.12371 (verify against the paper).

chemistry_small.label: Small active-space chemistry (100 logical qubits)
chemistry_small.source: ASSUMPTION: illustrative mid-size fault-tolerant task for architecture comparison (not from a paper).

vqe_50q.label: Variational solver, 50 qubits, GPU optimiser
vqe_50q.source: ASSUMPTION: illustrative hybrid loop; each iteration samples the circuit, then a GPU step updates the parameters.

vqe_20q.label: Variational solver, 20 qubits, GPU optimiser
vqe_20q.source: ASSUMPTION: illustrative; small enough that exact classical simulation is cheap, which makes the energy comparison instructive.

qla_full_vector_1m.label: Quantum linear solve, N = 2^20, full solution vector read out
qla_full_vector_1m.source: Illustrative cost model (qsvt: queries = 2 kappa ln(2/eps); block encoding 4 s log2 N Toffoli; loading N x rot_bits Toffoli per run; full-vector tomography needs about N/eps^2 runs). Order of magnitude, ASSUMPTION. Classical: conjugate gradient, 2 N s sqrt(kappa) ln(2/eps) flops.

qla_scalar_explicit_1m.label: Quantum linear solve, N = 2^20, one scalar observable of the solution (explicit data loading)
qla_scalar_explicit_1m.source: As qla_full_vector_1m, but amplitude estimation: (loading + inversion) / eps Toffoli in one coherent run. ASSUMPTION.

qla_scalar_implicit_1e12.label: Quantum linear solve, N = 2^40, scalar observable, input given by an efficient oracle (no explicit loading)
qla_scalar_implicit_1e12.source: The regime where QLA is argued to matter at all: structured problem, efficiently describable input, one number out, well-conditioned. Whether a classical method with comparable cost exists (e.g. tensor networks) is NOT assessed; no advantage is claimed. ASSUMPTION.
